title: Draw Markers
text: Draw markers on image, 7 inputs, 4 outputs, {Opacity factor (between 0 and 1)} sets Opacity factor; {Marker shape} sets the shape of marker, {Marker size} sets the size of marker, {Filled}, {Border color source} sets the color source of marker border Specify via, {Border color} sets the color value, {Fill color source} sets the color source of filled marker Specify via, {Fill color} sets the color value of filled, {Color value(s)} sets the user-specified color values, {Draw Markers in} sets the area for markers, {Use antialiasing} sets the smoothing algorithm and {Image signal} sets the port configuration for RGB image One multidimensional. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Marker shape
params.values: Shape of marker Circle (default) | X-mark | Plus | Star | Square

params.name: Border color source
params.values: Color source of marker border Specify via dialog (default) | Input port

params.name: Border color
params.values: Color value of marker Black (default) | White | User-specified value

params.name: Fill color source
params.values: Color source of filled marker Specify via dialog (default) | Input port

params.name: Fill color
params.values: Color value of filled marker Black (default) | White | User-specified value

params.name: Opacity factor (between 0 and 1)
params.values: Opacity factor 0.6 (default) | scalar in range [ 0, 1 ] | K -element vector

params.name: Color value(s)
params.values: User-specified color values [200 255 100] (default) | scalar | P -element vector | K -by- P matrix

params.name: Draw Markers in
params.values: Area for markers Entire image (default) | Specify region of interest via port

params.name: Image signal
params.values: Port configuration for RGB image One multidimensional signal (default) | Separate color signals
